### Given Data:
* Tension in portion DE ($T_{DE}$) = Weight at E = $300\text{ N}$ (Since the string passes over a smooth peg/pulley at D without friction, tension remains constant throughout CD).
* Therefore, Tension in CD ($T_{CD}$) = $300\text{ N}$.
* Angle of segment BC with horizontal = $0^\circ$.
* Angle of AB with BC = $150^\circ$ (Inside angle below horizontal, $\theta_1 = 180^\circ - 150^\circ = 30^\circ$).
* Angle of CD with BC = $120^\circ$ (Inside angle below horizontal, $\theta_2 = 180^\circ - 120^\circ = 60^\circ$).

---

### (i) Finding Tensions in portions AB, BC, and CD:

Since portion DE carries $300\text{ N}$, the tension in CD is:
$$T_{CD} = 300\text{ N}$$

**At Joint C:**
Resolving forces horizontally and vertically:
* **$\sum F_x = 0$:** 
  $$T_{CD} \cos(60^\circ) - T_{BC} = 0$$
  $$300 \times 0.5 - T_{BC} = 0 \implies T_{BC} = 150\text{ N}$$-

* **$\sum F_y = 0$:** 
  $$T_{CD} \sin(60^\circ) - W_2 = 0$$
  $$W_2 = 300 \sin(60^\circ) = 300 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 259.81\text{ N}$$

**At Joint B:**
Resolving forces horizontally and vertically:
* **$\sum F_x = 0$:** 
  $$T_{AB} \cos(30^\circ) - T_{BC} = 0$$
  $$T_{AB} \cos(30^\circ) = 150 \implies T_{AB} = \frac{150}{\cos(30^\circ)} = \frac{150}{0.866} = 173.21\text{ N}$$

* **$\sum F_y = 0$:** 
  $$T_{AB} \sin(30^\circ) - W_1 = 0$$
  $$W_1 = 173.21 \sin(30^\circ) = 173.21 \times 0.5 = 86.6\text{ N}$$ 

---

### Summary of Answers:
* **(i)** Tensions: $T_{AB} = 173.21\text{ N}$, $T_{BC} = 150\text{ N}$, $T_{CD} = 300\text{ N}$.
* **(ii)** Weights: $W_1 = 86.6\text{ N}$, $W_2 = 259.81\text{ N}$.
proTip: Always isolate joints (B and C) as free bodies and apply equations of equilibrium ($\sum F_x = 0$ and $\sum F_y = 0$).
